generation_rule: Inject deterministic synthetic execution reports into isolated VSSF memory and apply identity-collision variants to isolated PositionLotStore and FeeLedger instances; do not invoke a broker, collector, account API, or Production runtime.

scenario.same_order_duplicate: identical payload repeated under one client_order_id
scenario.same_order_conflict: same execution_id with different quantity/price payload under one client_order_id
scenario.cross_order_collision: same execution_id and same fill payload attached to two different client_order_ids
